scenes.text: Impossible events cannot happen, certain events must happen, and possible events may happen.
Classify the event: rolling a zero on an ordinary six-sided die. The answer is impossible. A standard die has faces 1–6; this outcome is impossible.
A player at a science exhibition is rolling a zero on an ordinary six-sided die. How likely is this event? Pause the video and think.
